_note: Safe zones are fractions of the canvas. minText/headlineMin are canvas pixels. Sources and dates: references/visuals.md (רף הסוכנות). Check the platform's current spec before a paid campaign.

landscape-191.use: Link ads, Google Demand Gen/PMax landscape 1.91:1, LinkedIn single image
